# Virtual Auditor

> > Virtual Auditor provides end-to-end business registration, compliance, and financial services including MCA company registration, GST filing, trademark protection, and startup valuation across India.

Virtual Auditor is a comprehensive business services platform offering MCA-approved company registrations (Private Limited, OPC, Partnership), GST and tax compliance, DGFT import-export licensing, trademark services, IBBI-registered startup valuations, and QuickBooks-certified accounting. The platform serves entrepreneurs and businesses across India with digital signature certificates, professional tax registration, and ongoing corporate compliance support.

## Key Topics

- MCA (Ministry of Corporate Affairs) Registration
- GST Registration & Compliance
- Private Limited Company Formation
- Startup Valuation (IBBI-registered)
- Trademark Registration & Protection
- DGFT Import-Export Code
- Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)
- Corporate Compliance & Board Resolutions
- MSME Registration
- Accounting & Bookkeeping Services
- Tax Filing (TDS/TAN)
- Partnership & Proprietorship Registration
- Shop Act & Professional Tax
- Articles of Association (AOA)
- QuickBooks Certified Services

## Company Registration Services

- [How to Register a Company | Company Registration Online](https://virtualauditor.in/private-limited-company-registration): MCA company registration service with RUN and SPICE INC-32 filing
- [One Person Company Registration - OPC Registration Procedure in India](https://virtualauditor.in/one-person-company): OPC registration under Companies Act 2013 with MCA filing
- [Partnership Firm Registration - Virtual Auditor](https://virtualauditor.in/partnership-registration): Partnership firm registration with deed drafting support across India
- [Proprietorship Registration - Get Started with VirtualAuditor](https://virtualauditor.in/proprietorship-registration-india-sole-proprietorship): Sole proprietorship registration with GST and PAN setup

## Tax & Compliance Services

- [GST Registration | Registration Fees & Online Process in India](https://virtualauditor.in/gst-registration): GSTIN registration service under CGST Act 2017 for businesses
- [TAN Registration - Virtual Auditor](https://virtualauditor.in/tan-registration): TAN registration for TDS deduction with Form 49B filing
- [Online Professional Tax Registration mumbai - VirtualAuditor](https://virtualauditor.in/professional-tax-registration-mumbai): Professional tax registration for employers in Mumbai, Maharashtra
- [Shop Act Registration In Mumbai - Virtual Auditor](https://virtualauditor.in/shop-act-registration-mumbai): Shop and Establishment Act license registration in Mumbai

## Valuation & Financial Services

- [Valuation of Startup Company - Startup Valuation | VirtualAuditor](https://virtualauditor.in/startup-valuation): IBBI-registered valuers for startup and business valuation certificates
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping Services | Accounts Outsourcing](https://virtualauditor.in/accounting-bookkeeping-services): QuickBooks-certified bookkeeping with GST returns and tax prep
- [Payroll Service](https://virtualauditor.in/payroll-service): Payroll management and compliance services for businesses

## Trademark & Intellectual Property

- [Trademark Objection Reply - VirtualAuditor](https://virtualauditor.in/trademark-objection): File trademark objection replies under Trademark Act 1999
- [Trademark Renewal - Online Application - Virtual Auditor](https://virtualauditor.in/trademark-renewal): Trademark renewal application for 10-year validity extension

## Corporate Amendments & Licenses

- [Change Company Name Online - Virtual Auditor](https://virtualauditor.in/company-name-change): MCA-approved company name change service with ROC compliance and filing
- [Increase Authorized Capital - Virtual Auditor](https://virtualauditor.in/authorized-capital): Share capital increase with MoA amendment and board resolution filing
- [Online Import Export Code (IE Code) Registration - Virtual Auditor](https://virtualauditor.in/import-export-code): DGFT IE Code registration for import-export businesses
- [Apply for Digital Signature Class 3 Online](https://virtualauditor.in/dsc-class-three): Class 3 DSC with e-token for tenders and government transactions
